policy.source:
package checkpoint
namespace checkpoint

entity AssemblyObservation id "gooo://tools/assembly-observation" fields {
    field matched id "gooo://tools/assembly-observation/matched" type integer required one
    field total id "gooo://tools/assembly-observation/total" type integer required one
    field best id "gooo://tools/assembly-observation/best" type integer required one
    field scored id "gooo://tools/assembly-observation/scored" type integer required one
    field budget id "gooo://tools/assembly-observation/budget" type integer required one
}

entity Explanation id "gooo://tools/assembly-explanation" fields {
    field state id "gooo://tools/assembly-explanation/state" type string required one
    field next_operation id "gooo://tools/assembly-explanation/next-operation" type string required one
    field message id "gooo://tools/assembly-explanation/message" type string required one
}

activity Checkpoint(AssemblyObservation) -> Explanation computes `return Explanation{state: "PROGRESS", next_operation: "USE_OBSERVED_CANDIDATE", message: "현재까지 관측한 후보를 저장합니다. / Save the observed candidate."}`

decisions.message: 현재까지 관측한 후보를 저장합니다. / Save the observed candidate.

package diagnostics
namespace diagnostics
entity Integer id "gooo://diagnostics/integer"
entity Text id "gooo://diagnostics/text"
entity Diagnostic id "gooo://diagnostics/diagnostic" fields {
    field code id "gooo://diagnostics/code" type string required one
    field message id "gooo://diagnostics/message" type string required one
    field action id "gooo://diagnostics/action" type string required one
}
activity Diagnose(Integer, Integer, Integer, Text) -> Diagnostic computes "var action = \"expand-examples\"\nif input2 > 0 { action = \"repair-and-replay\" }\nif input1 > 0 && input0 >= 0 && input0 < input1 && input2 >= 0 {\n    return Diagnostic{code: \"complete\", message: \"All observed fields matched.\", action: action}\n}\nif input0 < 0 || input1 < 0 || input2 < 0 || input0 > input1 {\n    action = \"fix-counts\"\n    return Diagnostic{code: \"invalid-counts\", message: input3, action: action}\n}\nif input1 == 0 {\n    return Diagnostic{code: \"unobserved\", message: \"Add expected observations.\", action: \"add-examples\"}\n}\nreturn Diagnostic{code: \"complete\", message: \"All observed fields matched.\", action: \"accept\"}" assembling {
    baseline "let action = \"expand-examples\"\nif input2 > 0 { action = \"repair-and-replay\" }\nif input1 > 0 && input0 >= 0 && input0 < input1 && input2 >= 0 {\n    return Diagnostic{code: \"complete\", message: \"All observed fields matched.\", action: action}\n}\nif input0 < 0 || input1 < 0 || input2 < 0 || input0 > input1 {\n    action = \"fix-counts\"\n    return Diagnostic{code: \"invalid-counts\", message: input3, action: action}\n}\nif input1 == 0 {\n    return Diagnostic{code: \"unobserved\", message: \"Add expected observations.\", action: \"add-examples\"}\n}\nreturn Diagnostic{code: \"complete\", message: \"All observed fields matched.\", action: \"accept\"}"
    picked "code" -> "value_first"
    picked "message" -> "value_first"
    picked "action" -> "value_first"
    choice "code" field_value at "0" alternative "\"partial\"" intent "부분 충족이면 partial 코드로 표시한다. Use partial for incomplete observations."
    choice "message" field_value at "1" alternative "input3" intent "실제 남은 부분을 입력의 진단 문장으로 전달한다. Keep the supplied diagnostic detail."
    choice "action" field_value at "2" alternative "\"accept\"" intent "현재 action 변수에 계산한 다음 작업을 유지한다. Keep the current action variable."
    value_case "[12,15,1,\"type-rejected candidate retained\"]" -> "{\"action\":\"repair-and-replay\",\"code\":\"partial\",\"message\":\"type-rejected candidate retained\"}"
    value_case "[2,4,0,\"사유 필드가 남았습니다\"]" -> "{\"action\":\"expand-examples\",\"code\":\"partial\",\"message\":\"사유 필드가 남았습니다\"}"
    value_case "[4,4,0,\"\"]" -> "{\"action\":\"accept\",\"code\":\"complete\",\"message\":\"All observed fields matched.\"}"
    value_case "[0,0,0,\"\"]" -> "{\"action\":\"add-examples\",\"code\":\"unobserved\",\"message\":\"Add expected observations.\"}"
    value_case "[5,4,0,\"passed exceeds total\"]" -> "{\"action\":\"fix-counts\",\"code\":\"invalid-counts\",\"message\":\"passed exceeds total\"}"
    attempts "8"
}

model.scope: one constructor load; excluded from request timing; fresh source and plan each request

composition.scope: source-declared typed value graph; finite activity selection and independently compiled graph execution are separate observations

input_separation.scope: unique root-input tuples; actual inputs at every assembling activity compared with source selection/holdout cases and recorded probes; all supplied expectations across duplicate rows must match; model-training exposure is unknown

runtime.scope: two fresh compiled value-graph executions; finite named expectations; explicit edges and ordered actual values; zero inference during replay/execution
